claims.title: P2 proposed covalent handoff: conditional chemistry and scaling

quoted_fields.interface: P2 proposes a chemically challenged peptide covalent handoff. Conditional graph connectivity is not chemical identity. The source gives model wrong-bond/scaling limits,not an integrated cycle,qualified selectivity or practical advantage.
quoted_fields.failure: Wrong stable alpha bonds can pass both predicates. Actual challenge/accessibility,damage,handle survival and chemical readback remain unqualified. Replaceable convergent modules do not preserve one irreplaceable original root;old same-scaffold repair stays separate.
